product.title: New Orleans Heart of the City Bicycle Tour

description.text: Ride beyond the French Quarter on a small-group New Orleans bicycle tour through historic neighborhoods including Faubourg Marigny, Bywater, and Treme. The route starts on North Rampart Street, uses a three-hour format, and includes stops near the Mississippi River, Jackson Square, and St. Roch Community Church while the guide shares stories about the city's multicultural origins and Creole culture.

highlights: Explore New Orleans historic neighborhoods on a guided bike tour.
Ride beyond the French Quarter into Faubourg Marigny, Bywater, and Treme.
Stop near the Mississippi River, Jackson Square, and St. Roch Community Church.
Join a small-group ride limited to 10 travelers with bicycle, helmet, and bottled water included.

start.description: 626 N Rampart St, New Orleans, LA 70116.

end.description: This activity ends back at the meeting point.

itineraryItems.title: Flambeaux Bicycle Tours & Bike Rentals
itineraryItems.description: Begin with about 15 minutes at Flambeaux Bicycle Tours & Bike Rentals for check-in, bike setup, and route orientation.

itineraryItems.title: Mississippi River
itineraryItems.description: Stop near the Mississippi River for about 10 minutes during the early part of the route.

itineraryItems.title: Jackson Square
itineraryItems.description: Visit Jackson Square during a 15-minute stop in the French Quarter area.

itineraryItems.title: Faubourg Marigny
itineraryItems.description: Ride through Faubourg Marigny during a 30-minute neighborhood segment beyond the French Quarter.

itineraryItems.title: Bywater District
itineraryItems.description: Continue into the Bywater District for about 30 minutes as the route expands into less-touristy New Orleans neighborhoods.

itineraryItems.title: St. Roch Community Church
itineraryItems.description: Stop near St. Roch Community Church for about 20 minutes while learning local neighborhood context.

itineraryItems.title: Treme
itineraryItems.description: Ride through Treme during a 20-minute segment connected to New Orleans cultural history.

itineraryItems.title: Flambeaux Bicycle Tours
itineraryItems.description: Return to Flambeaux Bicycle Tours for a short five-minute wrap-up at the end of the loop.

additionalInfo: Not recommended for travelers with back problems.
Travelers should have a strong physical fitness level.
All participants must be over 4 feet 11 inches.
A maximum of 10 people per booking applies.
This tour has a maximum of 10 travelers.
You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

faqs.question: Where does the Heart of the City Bicycle Tour meet?
faqs.answer: The tour meets at 626 North Rampart Street in New Orleans.

faqs.question: Does this bike tour return to the meeting point?
faqs.answer: Yes. The activity ends back at the North Rampart Street meeting point.

faqs.question: How long is the Heart of the City Bicycle Tour?
What neighborhoods does the tour visit?
faqs.answer: The route includes areas such as the French Quarter, Faubourg Marigny, Bywater, and Treme.
